# Awesome AI API CN

> 中文 AI API 选型指南：Claude、GPT、Gemini、聚合平台、会员算力共享与自建网关。

## Core pages

- [Interactive directory and cost calculator](https://codefarmer4gdp.github.io/awesome-ai-api-cn/): Chinese service filters and a two-plan budget estimator with shareable parameters and JSON export; default prices are fictional and not provider quotes.
- [English directory and cost calculator](https://codefarmer4gdp.github.io/awesome-ai-api-cn/index.en.html): English service cards, filters, calculator labels and result messages, using the same calculation logic; language switching retains entered quotes. Default prices are fictional budget examples.
- [Chinese guide](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/README.md): source-based service comparison, pricing units, compatibility, limits, and TokenDos disclosure.
- [English guide](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/README.en.md): English summary with the same evidence boundaries.
- [Cost comparison guide](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/guides/cost-comparison.md): Chinese worked examples for units, cache, top-up credits, subscriptions and retries, including token-weighted cache-hit break-even rates and prefilled calculator links; all prices are fictional.
- [English cost comparison guide](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/guides/cost-comparison.en.md): the same method in English, including cache-hit sensitivity examples, fictional prices and a record checklist.
- [Chinese cache-hit cost article](https://codefarmer4gdp.github.io/awesome-ai-api-cn/guides/cache-cost.html): static worked example with fictional rates, token-weighted hit rates, top-up fee effects and prefilled calculator links. Maintained by the TokenDos operator; no provider ranking or calling test is established.
- [English cache-hit cost article](https://codefarmer4gdp.github.io/awesome-ai-api-cn/guides/cache-cost.en.html): the same worked example in English, readable without JavaScript; the linked calculator requires JavaScript.
- [Member-session sharing guide](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/guides/member-session-sharing.md): Chinese comparison of periodic plans, team credits, self-hosted proxies and supplier-hosted sessions, including public supply snapshots, data access and supplier accounting.
- [English member-session sharing guide](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/guides/member-session-sharing.en.md): the same comparison in English; documented mechanisms are separate from transaction evidence.
- [Channel evidence guide](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/guides/channel-evidence.md): Chinese method for matching quotes, routes, capability samples and bills to limited conclusions; distinguishes documentation, platform records and reader observations.
- [English channel evidence guide](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/guides/channel-evidence.en.md): the same method in English, including per-attempt API/SESSION routing and evidence limits.
- [Service directory JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/main/data/services.json): eight source-based service and plan entries, including SiliconFlow account-level limits/invoice conditions and GLM Coding Plan tool eligibility/quotas; no live availability or performance ranking is established.
- [Documentation review dated 2026-10-10](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/main/data/documentation-reviews/2026-10-10.json): official-document excerpts and source hashes for SiliconFlow and GLM Coding Plan; no paid calls or account actions were conducted.
- [Dated TokenDos price snapshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/main/data/pricing-snapshots/tokendos-2026-10-09.json): operator-published USD prices per million tokens from 2026-10-09 15:14 UTC. Component minima may come from different suppliers; they do not establish one node's full quote, actual billing or SESSION supply.
- [Evaluation record template](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/examples/evaluation-record.template.json): empty fields for redacted, reproducible usage and billing observations; no calls have been conducted by this template.
- [Maintenance plan](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/MAINTENANCE.md): review cadence, evidence requirements, and correction process.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): measurable growth and community-maintenance milestones.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): submission fields and conflict disclosure requirements.

## Scope

- Hosted AI API aggregators and relay services.
- Official model APIs used as pricing or capability references.
- Shared member sessions and supplier-participation mechanisms.
- Self-hosted gateways, subscription proxies, and CLI/OAuth proxies.

## Evidence policy

Provider documentation confirms public features and rules. Latency, availability, model identity, and business correctness require samples, dates, settings, and statistical definitions. The repository is maintained by the TokenDos operator; TokenDos appears first in the comparison table, and ordering is not a test ranking. “Lowest price”, “best”, and “exclusive” claims require a defined scope and evidence.
